observations: Photo 0 shows a blue frame bicycle with very thick/big tires (fat-tire style).
Front wheel, fork, handlebars, and frame are visible; pedals and drivetrain area are partially visible.
No clear brand/model text is readable on the frame or tires in the photo.
No accessories (e.g., pump, lights, helmet, lock, tools) are shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Big tire bicycle with complete accessories
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the bicycle only; no accessories are pictured.

risks.risk: Whether the bicycle is complete and ride-ready (missing parts like pedals, reflectors, brakes, chain, or accessories).
risks.proof: A short video showing a full walk-around + close-ups of both brakes, chain/derailleur area, pedals, and a laid-out photo of every accessory included.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a bicycle that may be missing/needs parts (worst case: not fully complete).

risks.risk: Brake condition and safety (pads/rotors may be worn or misaligned).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of both brake levers and close-up of brake pads/rotors, plus a test clip braking from slow speed.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as brakes needing service/adjustment.

risks.risk: Wheel/tire condition (fat tires can have sidewall damage, uneven wear, or leaks).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire sidewalls and tread, and a clip spinning each wheel; show any valve/inner tube condition if visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as tires may need replacement or may be leaking.

risks.risk: Frame size/fit and overall build quality (fat bikes vary widely by size and components).
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size marking (if any) and a measurement shot (seat tube length or rider-fit height range).
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the lowest spec/size expectation for fat-tire bikes.

proof_requests: Lay out and photograph every accessory included (pump, lights, lock, helmet, tools, reflectors, etc.) and confirm quantities.
Close-up photos of drivetrain (chain, sprocket/cassette), both brake systems, and pedal condition.
Video test: straight ride + hard braking + turning both directions.
Photos of tire sidewalls and tread, plus confirmation of whether tires are tubeless or tube and whether there are any leaks.
response.reason: The photo confirms a fat-tire bicycle, but the seller’s key claim about “complete accessories” is not shown, and safety/condition details (brakes, tires, completeness) are not verifiable from this single image. To price confidently, we need proof of completeness and ride-ready condition.
